en.headline: Hive Christmas markets open today in Sai Ying Pun and Sai Kung
en.dek: The Hive holds free community Christmas markets from 1pm to 6pm today at its Poho and Sai Kung venues, featuring local makers, food and live music.
body: The Hive Hong Kong is holding its annual Christmas markets today at two locations across the city.

At the Hive Poho in Sai Ying Pun the market runs from 1pm to 6pm at 5-13 New Street. Organisers said it features independent local makers offering handcrafted items, festive food and drinks, and live performances including Flute Utopia and Harmonics Choir. Entry is free and the event is family and pet friendly. A paint-and-sip option is available for a fee.
A separate market is taking place at the Hive Sai Kung during the same hours. The organisers listed live music from local performers and a focus on local shopping and seasonal treats.
Both markets are free to enter. The Hive describes them as community events supporting independent businesses ahead of the holiday season.

zh.headline: Hive今日西營盤及西貢舉辦聖誕市集
zh.dek: Hive今日下午1時至6時在西營盤Poho及西貢場地舉辦免費社區聖誕市集，設本地手作、美食及現場音樂。
body: Hive香港今日於兩處場地舉行年度聖誕市集。
西營盤Hive Poho市集於新街5至13號舉行，時間由下午1時至6時。主辦單位表示，現場有本地獨立手作人提供手工製品、節日美食飲品，並有Flute Utopia及Harmonics Choir等現場表演。入場免費，歡迎家庭及寵物。另設收費繪畫品酒體驗。
西貢Hive同時舉辦另一場市集，主辦單位列出本地表演者現場音樂，並以本地購物及季節小食為重點。
兩場市集均免費入場。Hive形容這是支持獨立商家的社區活動，讓市民在節日前感受氣氛。
